name: World Wide Whites Flight
description: La Fiera Pinot Grigio, 2025 | Loosen Riesling, Germany, 2025 | Matua, Marlborough, NZ, 2025 | La Crema Chardonnay, Monterey, 2024
serverNotes: World tour of white wines, light to full: Italian Pinot Grigio, German Riesling, New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc and California Chardonnay. Pinot Grigio pairs beautifully with Shrimp Scampi or Fried Calamari. Riesling complements spicier dishes like Roasted Pork Belly. Sauvignon Blanc matches Jumbo Shrimp Cocktail or the Grilled Caesar. Chardonnay pairs with Chicken Piccata or Grilled Octopus. Great for exploring white wine styles across appetizers and seafood.

name: Old World vs. New World Flight
description: Grand Enclos du Château de Cérons, Bordeaux, 2019 | Rubio by San Polo, IGT, Montalcino, JS 91, 2023 | Greenwing Cabernet by Duckhorn, Columbia Valley, 2023 | "The Pessimist" by Daou, 2023
serverNotes: Old World against New World reds, side by side: Bordeaux and a Montalcino Super Tuscan, then Washington and Paso Robles Cabernet. Grand Enclos (Bordeaux) shows savory cedar and graphite; Rubio by San Polo (JS 91) brings Tuscan cherry and herbs; Greenwing by Duckhorn is ripe, polished Washington fruit; The Pessimist by Daou is bold Paso Robles power. Taste left to right, lighter to bigger. Great with Chicken or Eggplant Parmesan and Ragu of Italian Meats for the Old World pours, and steaks, Veal Chop Parmesan or Short Rib for the New World ones.

name: World Renowned Winemakers Flight
description: Guado Al Tasso, Vermentino, Tuscany, 2025 | Cakebread "Mullan Road" Washington, 2022 | Caparzo Brunello di Montalcino, DOCG, 2021 | Rombauer Chardonnay, Carneros, 2024
serverNotes: Premium wine flight for special occasions - pairs with our finest dishes. Vermentino complements Lobster Stuffed Shells or Grilled Octopus. Red blend pairs with Veal Marsala or Filet Mignon. Brunello matches our premium steaks, Osso Buco, or Veal Chop Parmesan. Rombauer Chardonnay pairs with Pan Roasted Salmon or rich seafood dishes. World-class wines from legendary producers for an elevated dining experience. Perfect for anniversaries, celebrations, or wine enthusiasts wanting the best pairings with our signature dishes.
